{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "yuvicc",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK, but noted that pruned block queries returned an I/O error instead of 'Block not available'"
    },
    {
      "login": "musaHaruna",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK and suggested wrapping functional test assertions in try...finally"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3593301703",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "In pruned mode, requesting a pruned block returns 'I/O error reading block data' instead of 'Block not available'",
      "quote": "In pruned mode when user calls `getrawtransaction <txid> <blockhash>` for the block that is pruned we return `\"I/O error reading block data\"` instead we should return `\"Block not available\"` which was done previously?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "maflcko added CheckBlockDataAvailability check and pushed the fix along with yuvicc's test draft",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4084800456"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4084800456",
      "status_by_quote": "I've pushed your test draft and my fix"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3595197636",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Wrap functional test assertions in a try...finally block so the renamed block file is always restored",
      "quote": "would it be safer to wrap the assertions in a `try...finally` block so that the block file is always restored, even if an assertion or unexpected exception causes the test to exit early.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "maflcko explained teardown deletes the temporary test directory anyway so restoring the file is unnecessary",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3595248537",
        "rc:4084843804"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4084843804",
      "status_by_quote": "I don’t think a finally block is needed here: if an assertion fails, the functional test’s temporary datadir is deleted during teardown, so restoring the renamed file provides no practical benefit."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:4988714009",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Distinguishing “transaction not found” from internal read failures in `TxIndex::FindTx/GetTransaction` makes sense.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "TxIndex::FindTx/GetTransaction"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4713363862",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "separating expected outcomes (\"transaction not found\") from unexpected failures (I/O errors)",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "re-review from yuvicc and musaHaruna following author responses and force push",
      "id": "c:5798802405"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Updated yuvicc's objection to clear with change (bug fix) and marked it fixed following maflcko's push and test inclusion. Added musaHaruna's suggestion regarding try...finally in the test, which was answered by maflcko; musaHaruna's accompanying question about adding a code comment was treated as a style preference."
}
